title: Meter aggregation and CLI output for sentiment scores
description: Aggregate per-message sentiment into the meter report per window and per source: mean compound score and pos/neu/neg message counts, counts only. Wire into CLI text and JSON output and the config surface (backend selection flag/key). Done when: meter tests cover the new aggregates; CLI text/JSON show them; nothing text-bearing is persisted.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Meter aggregation wired: SentimentAggregate (backend, scoredMessages, meanCompound, pos/neu/neg) on MeterReport and perSource, populated by computeMeter when a backend is configured; runSentimentMeter defaults to the local vader backend (empty string disables); CLI gains --sentiment-backend flag (config key sentimentBackend), text output gains Sentiment and Sentiment per source lines, JSON gains sentiment plus per-source aggregates; 12 new meter/CLI tests; full suite 1604 passing.
